text:
maya: Quick thread on the newsletter launch: want to include dynamic content blocks per segment + a short progressive profiling ASK for product fit. Can we keep the send under 200k recipients.

lina: I can build dynamic blocks in SendGrid using substitution tags. Two ideas:
- Block A: "For infra teams" (latency + SLA checklist)
- Block B: "For app devs" (integration + SDK speed)
- Block C: "For platform teams" (dedicated & private options)
We should map segment -> block via `segment_type` column in CSV.

sam: Segment definitions: trial-active (7d), trial-stalled (7-21d with no calls), paying-high-usage (>200k tokens/30d), partners & prospects (list from SDR). Also create re-engage micro-segment: opened >=2 emails but no demo clicks.

jenn: Progressive profiling idea: one-question micro survey in hero CTA to capture "primary use case" (options: chat, search, assistant, embeddings, other). Use this to update user profile without a long form. CTA flows:
- Click primary use case -> record event `newsletter_profile_usecase` -> route to tailored follow-ups.

maya: Love that. Important: keeps friction low. For the re-engage segment, we should try a content-first approach (benchmark highlights + 1-click demo link) vs product-first (checklist). Let's A/B those.

lina: For template naming: `newsletter_launch_v2_dynamic_A` (content-first) and `_B` (product-first). I'll add conditional code: `{{#if segment_type == "paying-high-usage"}} show Block C`. SendGrid uses handlebar-like syntax so test in staging.

sam: Routing/lead handling: Rule: if user clicks demo CTA AND is in paying-high-usage OR trial-active with >50k tokens -> immediate SDR handoff. Else enqueue to nurture path with 3-touch cadence. We'll need CRM mapping for `newsletter_profile_usecase` too.

jenn: Tracking & UTMs: utm_campaign=news_v2&utm_medium=email&utm_source=newsletter; utm_content should include block id and variant, e.g., `blockA_B` for A/B. Also append `profile_usecase={{usecase}}` to demo links for attribution.

maya: Metrics: Short-term (48-72h) look at demo_click_rate and profile completion. Mid-term (14d) MQL conversions and new trial starts. Success threshold: demo_click uplift +3pp vs baseline, profile completion >10% on first send.

lina: I'll push templates + preview links to the staging list and post links here. ETA: EOD today.

sam: I'll generate CSVs with segment_type and utm columns and drop in `campaign-config/launch_v2/`. File names: `launch_v2_segment_trial_active.csv`, etc. ETA: 4pm PT.

jenn: Also adding a small inline code snippet in the email for quick start (1-line): `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"Hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY'` Keep it safe & no full keys.

maya: Good catch. Ops: ensure legal signoff on benchmarking claims. @lina please add placeholder language: "based on internal benchmark, results may vary".

campaign-bot: Preview send scheduled: 2024-05-15T20:00:00Z to staging list (size: 200).

maya: Thanks team. Quick confirmations when you push assets/PRs so I can review before the Thu send. :rocket:
